Markets.title: Salesforce raises annual revenue forecasts on AI product momentum
Markets.summary: Salesforce raised its fiscal 2027 revenue forecast to between $46.1 billion and $46.4 billion while also increasing its adjusted earnings guidance. The upward revision, driven by strong demand for AI-powered autonomous agents, caused company shares to jump 7% in extended trading.

Markets.title: Nvidia earnings: Chipmaker forecasts Q3 revenue at $108 billion, above analysts' estimates as Q2 profit, revenue double YoY
Markets.summary: Nvidia reported that its second-quarter profit and revenue doubled year-over-year and forecast third-quarter revenue of $108 billion, beating analyst estimates. The chipmaker also announced a projected trillion-dollar market opportunity for its AI chips through 2027 despite increasing competition.

Markets.title: HP forecasts strong fourth-quarter profit on price hikes, US tariff refunds
Markets.summary: HP forecasted a fourth-quarter profit above Wall Street estimates, driven by expected tariff refunds and higher prices for its PCs. The company also raised its full-year adjusted earnings forecast as strong demand for AI-powered computers boosted third-quarter revenue.

Markets.title: US stocks today: US stocks end near flat as hot inflation data clouds Fed rate outlook
Markets.summary: US stocks finished nearly flat as higher-than-expected inflation complicated the Federal Reserve's interest-rate outlook. Investors are now awaiting Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh's Jackson Hole speech for clues on future policy decisions.

Markets.title: US corporate profit margins widen to highest on record
Markets.summary: US corporate profit margins reached a record 19.4% in the second quarter as profits jumped nearly 10%. This growth was driven by strong consumer spending, higher prices passed on to customers, and robust business investment.

Markets.title: Next market winners: Jefferies sees potential in data centers as hyperscalers race for AI capacity
Markets.summary: Jefferies reports that hyperscalers are rapidly increasing data center leases due to AI capacity demands and power constraints. North American non-commenced leases reached 25.5 gigawatts in the second quarter of 2026, creating new opportunities for third-party operators.

Geo-Political.title: Heart, hope and a steely determination: Dolly Parton's musical legacy
Geo-Political.summary: BBC music correspondent Mark Savage examines the musical legacy of the late singer Dolly Parton. He highlights her heart, hope, and steely determination as defining traits of her irreplaceable career.

Geo-Political.title: Door was locked at Pakistan hospital where fire killed 14 babies, witnesses say
Geo-Political.summary: Witnesses reported that the door to a Pakistan hospital ward was locked during a fire that killed 14 babies. The hospital disputed this claim, stating to the BBC that the door was manned by security guards rather than locked.

Geo-Political.title: Trump officials threaten Kennedy Center demolition if court blocks renovations
Geo-Political.summary: Trump administration officials have threatened to demolish the Kennedy Center if a court blocks its ongoing renovations. Additionally, the Justice Department has requested that Donald Trump's name be restored to the building after its removal in June.

Geo-Political.title: US drug agency approves breakthrough treatment for pancreatic cancer
Geo-Political.summary: The US drug agency has approved daraxonrasib as a breakthrough treatment for pancreatic cancer. Experts have hailed this new medication as a major advancement for one of the deadliest forms of cancer.

Geo-Political.title: Canada announces 'dollar-for-dollar' retaliatory tariffs on US as high as 50%
Geo-Political.summary: Canada has announced retaliatory tariffs of up to 50% on American goods, including steel, furniture, fresh tuna, and makeup. This move marks a significant escalation in the ongoing trade war between the United States and Canada.

Geo-Political.title: Far-right Israeli lawmaker damages Palestinian memorial with sledgehammer
Geo-Political.summary: Far-right Israeli lawmaker Zvi Sukkot used a sledgehammer to damage a Palestinian memorial. His actions drew widespread condemnation, including from Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

Data & Insights.summary: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh faces the challenge at Jackson Hole of assuring markets he will control inflation without worsening bond market pressures. He must achieve this delicate balance to maintain investor confidence in the central bank's monetary policy.

Data & Insights.title: Egg prices up nearly 40%, may get more expensive this winter due to ethanol production: Here’s how
Data & Insights.summary: Indian egg prices have risen 35% to 40% over the past year, with retail prices currently reaching up to ₹9 per egg. Prices are expected to increase further this winter due to rising seasonal demand and ethanol production costs.

Data & Insights.title: India’s GDP growth likely slowed to a 4-quarter low of 7.4% in Q1: Mint poll
Data & Insights.summary: India's GDP growth likely slowed to a four-quarter low of 7.4% in the first quarter, according to a Mint poll. While industrial and services sectors supported the economy, agricultural activity was likely dampened by a delayed monsoon.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Explainer: Why does Niti Aayog want to change India’s skilling system?
Data & Insights.summary: Niti Aayog has proposed combining India's education and training into a single system to prepare workers for future jobs by 2047. This new framework shifts the focus from basic certification to securing actual employment.

Data & Insights.title: How India’s import dependence is spilling beyond oil, in charts
Data & Insights.summary: India's non-petroleum trade deficit is surging beyond crude oil due to a growing reliance on foreign electronics components and industrial inputs. This trend exposes the country's dependence on assembly rather than deep manufacturing.

Data & Insights.title: VCs look past payment figures to spot 'dead users' hiding in UPI autoPay metrics
Data & Insights.summary: Venture capitalists are looking beyond soaring UPI autoPay transaction volumes to evaluate actual app usage. This strategy helps investors identify dormant subscribers and determine the true value of startups.

India.title: Nepal Floods: 32-Member Kolkata Group Among Many From West Bengal Untraceable
India.summary: A 32-member group from Kolkata is among the 133 Indian nationals missing following flash floods in central Nepal. The disaster, which originated in Tibet, has killed over 100 people and left more than 750 overall unaccounted for.

India.title: Agonising Wait For News In Tamil Nadu As Nepal Flood Hits Pilgrim Convoy
India.summary: A convoy of pilgrims from Tamil Nadu was traveling in three buses toward Tibet when flash floods struck the region in Nepal. Families in India are currently experiencing an agonizing wait for news regarding their safety.

India.title: Viral Video Shows Assam Teacher On Census Duty With 2 Daughters By Her Side
India.summary: Assam teacher Rumi Deka shared a viral video showing her two young daughters accompanying her while she performs census field duties. The footage highlights the challenges working mothers face in balancing official responsibilities with childcare.

India.title: Why Nepal Is So Vulnerable: Glacial Lakes, And A Himalaya That Moves Constantly
India.summary: Nepal is highly vulnerable to disasters due to a constantly moving Himalayan region and dangerous glacial lakes. The August 26 inland tsunami was caused by this severe natural hazard exposure rather than random weather.

India.title: Cross-Border Drug Cartel Busted In J&K, Heroin Worth Crores Seized
India.summary: The Narcotics Control Bureau busted a cross-border drug cartel in Jammu and Kashmir, seizing 5.16 kilograms of high-grade heroin worth crores of rupees. Authorities arrested the mastermind of the operation along with two other traffickers.

India.title: Key Mountain Development Institute Warns Of Second Flood In Nepal
India.summary: Scientists warn that an upstream blockage near the Nepal-China border could cause a second flood. This follows Wednesday's flash floods that struck the same area.

General.summary: Meta agreed to pay up to $18 billion to settle claims brought by U.S. states that its platforms harm children. The agreement was reached during a trial in a California federal court.

General.title: Woman who died in fire with niece, 7, was 'beautiful soul', mother tells BBC
General.summary: Two people have been arrested on suspicion of murder following a house fire in Middlesborough that killed a woman and her seven-year-old niece. The victim's mother described her daughter as a "beautiful soul" in an interview with the BBC.
